limitations: Kraken response has no exchange event timestamp; exact network retrieval time is not recorded.
OKX XRP-USDT quote is 26.8 minutes old at the run-start reference time and was not normalized to USD because no contemporaneous USDT/USD leg was captured.
Order-book observations are top-of-book only; no synchronized multi-venue Level 2 or sequence reconstruction.
The rendered JSON hashes are not hashes of independently captured HTTP wire bytes and have no external WORM/timestamp anchor.
ETF flow providers disagree on November 17; fund universes and completeness differ.
Derivatives providers disagree on open interest direction and totals; venue sets and timestamps differ.
Exchange-wallet totals include cold storage and wrapped-token reserves and are not tradable float.
Large-wallet custody interpretation is not confirmed by beneficial-owner evidence.
Evernorth's 473.276M XRP closing treasury is a mix of 388.911M in-kind contributions and 84.366M purchased with pooled cash proceeds; it is not 473M of fresh open-market buying.

Evernorth's Sep30 filing reports 346.285M XRP at historical cost $846.575M, impairment $271.037M and carrying value $341.887M; post-close holdings, liabilities, notes, warrants, ELOC and diluted shares must be reconciled before NAV analysis.
SBI's 9% Ripple equity statement is dated June 2025; no updated 2026 beneficial-ownership percentage was verified.
SBI Group's 36.1% voting rights and 20.5% economic interest in Evernorth are different measures because of share-class structure.
Circle SBI Japan K.K. / SBI Circle Holdings K.K. is a 50/50 JV separate from SBI Ripple Asia; Circle's Q3 2026 filing reports no significant operating results to date.
Standard Chartered's RLUSD collateral-mirroring relationship with LMAX is planned and conditional, not verified live.
OCC trust-bank effective dates do not establish full-service commercial deposit banking or actual XRP client balances.
The SEC's Rule 506 waiver does not vacate the Ripple injunction or erase the final judgment.
XRPSONAR's 24.67B tracked-wallet estimate and XRP Insights' 22.19B estimate use different wallet universes; no averaging.
ETF flow reports are provisional and incomplete; AUM/holdings changes must be separated from net flows.

ripple_sec_case.caution: No categorical statement that XRP is or is not a security in every transaction; the holding is transaction- and context-specific.
